author: TheMightyTRexUK

added: **A logo** in Settings, Plug-ins and in the Catalogue.
changed: Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.2.
Files are converted in a tdarr-cache folder on your media drives, not on the system disk, so working copies of large films cannot fill it. Starboard points its Films and Series libraries there.

fixed: The worker can download Tdarr's plug-ins: it has a folder it may write to.

added: Tdarr as a plug-in, outside the main install, on its own page on your home network.

description: Tdarr converts films and series to save space, in Starboard's quiet hours. It can copy the Tdarr you already have, with its libraries and history.
name: Tdarr
